releaseNotes:
🚀 v1.9.2 Release: Direct Google Account & Specific Calendar Picker
• 👤 Google Account Discovery: Select from any Google account authenticated on your device
• 📅 Specific Calendar Selection: Pick target booking calendar (Work, Jobs, Appointments, Primary) with native color badges
• 🧪 Test Event Creation: 1-tap live verification inserting sample events directly into Google Calendar
• 🔄 Automated Booking Sync: AI Receptionist and SMS agent book appointments directly into your selected calendar
